q: 他的房间___的，衣服和书到处都是。
en: His room is a total mess, with clothes and books everywhere.

q: 新搬来的邻居把楼道堆得___，大家都不高兴。
en: The new neighbour piled things up in the stairwell in a complete mess, and everyone was unhappy.

q: 妈妈说我做事___，连门都忘了锁。
en: Mum says I'm careless; I even forgot to lock the door.

q: 爸爸总是___，不是忘了带钥匙，就是忘了带手机。
en: Dad is always forgetting things: if it's not his keys, it's his phone.

q: 客人突然来了，妈妈___地收拾起客厅来。
en: The guests turned up suddenly, and Mum rushed around in a flap tidying the living room.

q: 小王上课___，一会儿看手机，一会儿看窗外。
en: Xiao Wang is half-hearted in class: one moment he looks at his phone, the next out of the window.

q: 你别___了，那首歌不是她唱的，是另一个歌手唱的。
en: Don't mix them up: she didn't sing that song, another singer did.

q: 这家饭店的服务员做事___，上错了三个菜。
en: The waiters at this restaurant are careless; they served three wrong dishes.

q: “你的钢琴弹得怎么样？”“___，还要多练习。”
en: “How is your piano playing?” “So-so; I need more practice.”

q: 他学吉他___，一边弹一边玩手机。
en: He learns the guitar half-heartedly, playing while fiddling with his phone.

q: 搬家那天，客厅里___的，到处都是箱子。
en: On moving day the living room was a mess, with boxes everywhere.

q: 这张照片的说明写错了人，把弟弟说成了哥哥，真是___。
en: The caption names the wrong person, calling the younger brother the older one; a real mix-up.

q: 我一向___，所以出门前都要检查一遍包。
en: I've always been forgetful, so I check my bag before I leave the house.

q: 闹钟没响，我___地穿好衣服，没吃早饭就冲出了门。
en: The alarm didn't go off, so I flung my clothes on in a panic and dashed out without breakfast.

q: 地铁里大家都在看手机，只有那个学生___地看书。
en: On the metro everyone is on their phone; only that student is reading with total concentration.

q: 为了考上大学，他___地复习，连周末都不休息。
en: To get into university he revised like mad, not even resting at the weekend.

q: 这家建筑公司做事___，每一块砖都要检查三遍。
en: This construction company is meticulous: every brick is checked three times.

q: 这次演出很重要，我们一定要___。
en: This performance matters, so we must give it everything.

q: 他学了三个月的小提琴，觉得太难就不学了，真是___。
en: He learned the violin for three months, found it too hard and quit; what a case of giving up halfway.

q: 为了买到演唱会的票，他___地托朋友帮忙。
en: To get a concert ticket he tried every possible way, asking friends for help.

q: 写新闻报道要___，不能夸大。
en: News reports must stick to the facts and not exaggerate.

q: 他看书___，连我走进房间都没发现。
en: He read with such concentration that he didn't even notice me come into the room.

q: 老师说，学外语不能___，要坚持每天练习。
en: The teacher says you mustn't give up halfway when learning a language; keep practising every day.

q: 为了写好这本小说，作家___地工作了两年。
en: To write this novel well, the author worked for two years, forgetting to eat and sleep.

q: 她修改歌词时___，一个字也不放过。
en: She is meticulous when revising lyrics, letting not a single word slip by.

q: 房东___想把房子租出去，价钱一降再降。
en: The landlord is trying every trick to rent the flat out, lowering the price again and again.

q: 足球赛已经开始了，球员们___，都想赢。
en: The match has begun and the players give it everything, all wanting to win.

q: 孩子们听说周末去动物园，一个个___。
en: The children heard they were going to the zoo at the weekend and were all in high spirits.

q: 她看着电影，___地吃着爆米花。
en: She ate popcorn with relish as she watched the film.

q: 演唱会明天就开始了，我___想听她唱新歌。
en: The concert is tomorrow and I can't wait to hear her sing the new songs.

q: 他___地抱着刚出生的女儿，生怕弄疼她。
en: He held his newborn daughter very carefully, afraid of hurting her.

q: 明天就要考试了，我心里___的，晚上睡不着。
en: The exam is tomorrow; I'm on edge and can't sleep tonight.

q: 听完导游的讲解，我才___：原来这座老房子是一百年前的火车站。
en: Only after the guide's explanation did it dawn on me: this old house was a railway station a hundred years ago.

q: 看到最后一幕，我___，原来凶手一直就在身边。
en: At the last scene it suddenly clicked: the killer had been right beside us all along.

q: 她第一次在电影院见到他，就对他___了。
en: The first time she saw him in the cinema, she fell for him at first sight.

q: 我对这座海边的小城___，决定在这里住下来。
en: I fell in love with this little seaside town at first sight and decided to settle here.

q: 爷爷看京剧看得___，连晚饭都忘了吃。
en: Grandpa watched Peking opera with such relish that he forgot his dinner.

q: 我___地想回家，看看三年没见的父母。
en: I can't wait to go home and see my parents, whom I haven't seen for three years.

q: 他们昨天还好好的，今天却___地吵起架来。
en: They were fine yesterday, but today they started quarrelling for no apparent reason.

q: 这么小的孩子就能用钢琴弹出一首完整的曲子，真___。
en: A child this small can play a whole piece on the piano; it's amazing.

q: 孩子长大了就要离开家，这是___的事。
en: Children leave home when they grow up; that is only natural.

q: “我们去看电影还是去逛街？”“都___，你决定吧。”
en: “Shall we see a film or go shopping?” “Either is fine, you decide.”

q: 这家餐厅的菜、服务和环境都很好，几乎___。
en: The food, service and atmosphere at this restaurant are all good; it's almost perfect.

q: 他很有钱，这点房租对他来说只是___。
en: He's rich; this bit of rent is a drop in the ocean for him.

q: ___，我明天都要去机场送你。
en: No matter what, I'm going to the airport to see you off tomorrow.

q: 这部电影的结尾很___，我看了两遍还是不懂。
en: The ending of this film is baffling; I watched it twice and still don't get it.

q: 他今天突然送我一束花，真让我觉得___。
en: He suddenly gave me a bunch of flowers today, which left me puzzled.

q: 他一天读完三本书，对我来说简直___。
en: He finishes three books in a day; to me that's simply unbelievable.

q: 住在哪个城区我都___，只要离地铁站近就行。
en: I don't mind which district I live in, as long as it's close to a metro station.

q: 这部电影到这里结束最好，后面又加了一段，真是___。
en: The film should have ended here; the extra section added later is a spoiling addition.

q: 你跟他讲古典音乐，就是___，他一点兴趣也没有。
en: Talking classical music to him is wasted effort; he has no interest at all.

q: 他一直坐在家里等好工作来找他，真是___。
en: He just sits at home waiting for a good job to come to him; he's waiting for luck to strike.

q: 邻居家被偷以后，小区才安上了新门锁，虽然晚了点，也算___。
en: Only after the neighbours were burgled did the estate fit new locks; a bit late, but better late than never.

q: 他从没离开过这个小城，却说外面的世界不过如此，真是个___。
en: He has never left this town yet says the outside world is nothing special; a real frog in a well.

q: 他说自己很喜欢安静，却天天把音乐开得很大声，这不是___吗？
en: He says he likes quiet but plays his music loud every day; isn't that contradictory?

q: 你对一个三岁的孩子讲这么多大道理，不是___吗？
en: Isn't it pointless to preach so many principles to a three-year-old?

q: 想在这个城市找到好房子，不能在家里___，要多去看看。
en: To find a good flat in this city you can't just sit at home hoping; you must go and look.

q: 这间屋子已经很漂亮了，再挂一幅画就成了___。
en: This room is already pretty; hanging one more picture would be overdoing it.

q: 他以前从不运动，生病以后才开始锻炼身体，这也是___。
en: He never exercised before; he only started after falling ill, but it's better late than never.

q: 你下周要开车回老家，路上要小心，祝你___。
en: You're driving back to your home town next week; take care, and have a safe journey.

q: 过年了，我给远方的朋友发信息：“祝你新年快乐，___！”
en: It's New Year and I message a friend far away: “Happy New Year, and all the best!”

q: 别人都说那个古镇很美，我去了才知道，真是___。
en: Everyone said that old town was beautiful, and only when I went did I understand: seeing is believing.

q: 这首曲子我每天练一小时，现在弹得越来越好了，真是___。
en: I practise this piece an hour every day and play it better and better; practice makes perfect.

q: 刚搬到新城市，当地人都吃得很辣，我也___，学着吃辣。
en: Having just moved to a new city where the locals eat very spicy food, I do as the Romans do and learn to eat spicy.

q: 骑自行车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是___。
en: Cycling to work saves money and keeps you fit; it kills two birds with one stone.

q: 去外地旅行前，朋友对我说：“___，到了给我发信息。”
en: Before my trip out of town, my friend said: “Have a safe journey, and message me when you arrive.”

q: 住进新家以后，我们参加了邻居的聚会，既认识了朋友又练习了汉语，真是___。
en: After moving into the new home we went to the neighbours' party, making friends and practising Chinese at once; two birds with one stone.

q: 在旧货市场买东西，大家都喜欢和老板___。
en: At the second-hand market everyone likes to haggle with the owner.

q: 书店里有___的书，从小说到漫画都有。
en: The bookshop has all kinds of books, from novels to comics.

q: 他一个人坐在公园里，嘴里___，好像在背课文。
en: He sat alone in the park muttering to himself, as if learning a text by heart.

q: 我没想清楚，那句话就___了，现在很后悔。
en: I hadn't thought it through and the remark just slipped out; now I regret it.

q: 这两个杯子颜色大小都___，我分不出哪个是我的。
en: These two cups are exactly alike in colour and size; I can't tell which is mine.

q: 我和哥哥的手机___，所以常常拿错。
en: My brother's phone and mine are identical, so we often pick up the wrong one.

q: 她和卖水果的阿姨___了半天，最后便宜了两块钱。
en: She haggled with the fruit seller for ages and got two yuan off in the end.

q: 这两个房间的布置___一模一样。
en: The decoration of these two rooms is exactly the same.

q: 他___那个女孩一见钟情了。
en: He fell for that girl at first sight.

q: 买菜的时候，妈妈总是___卖菜的人讨价还价。
en: When shopping for vegetables, Mum always haggles with the seller.

q: 他从不出远门，却看不起别的城市，简直就是一只___。
en: He never travels far yet looks down on other cities; he's simply a frog in a well.

q: 世界上没有___的家庭，每个家庭都有小矛盾。
en: There is no perfect family in the world; every family has small quarrels.

q: 孩子们___兴高采烈地唱着歌。
en: The children were singing in high spirits.

s: 我一见钟情了那个歌手。
这两家店的牌子很一模一样。
妈妈在菜市场讨价还价卖菜的人。
他很井底之蛙，从来没离开过这个村子。
孩子们很兴高采烈地跑进了新房子。
明天你要参加考试，祝你一路平安！
弟弟拿到新手机，七上八下地玩了一整天。
他每天坐在家里等工作自己找上门，真是亡羊补牢。
他检查文件一丝不苟，错了好几个字也没发现。
他的房间乱七八糟的，书和衣服都放得整整齐齐。
他把小说写到一半就不写了，真是全力以赴。
他对这座老城一见钟情，后来就留在那里工作了。
这两张地图完全一模一样。
她跟房东讨价还价，把房租降了两百块。
他是个井底之蛙，从来不听别人的意见。
这部电影太不可思议了，我看了三遍。
明天你要坐火车回老家，祝你一路平安！
听了老师的话，他才恍然大悟，原来自己一直弄错了。
他心里七上八下地等着面试的结果。
她喜欢听各种各样的音乐，从摇滚到古典都听。
